meta.note: Rent control rules checked against the ordinance text (ecode360.com/36623772). The 5% 'unconscionable' rule and the current CPI figure still come from news/secondary sources - see each rule's status.

rentControl.coverage: All rental buildings, except: owner-occupied buildings with 4 or fewer units, new construction, public housing, and certain subsidized units.
rentControl.status: Cap = CPI change, never above 4% (verified). Current CPI figure: call the Office of Rent Control.

unconscionable.status: Applies to units not under rent control. Fine up to $1,200 per unit (ROI-NJ); Gothamist reported $1,250. Ordinance text not yet found.

noticePeriod.status: 30 days' written notice to the tenant AND the Rent Regulation Officer, stating the increase, %, prior rent and allowable increase.

registration.status: No increase is allowed if the landlord has not met registration requirements.

legalHelp.name: Legal Services of New Jersey (LSNJ Legal Hotline)
Newark Office of Tenant Legal Services
legalHelp.source: Listed on the city's OTLS page as City of Newark contact info (may be the City Hall main line). CALL TO CONFIRM. Serves Newark tenants facing eviction, income at or below 200% of poverty level.
